focus: security and trust boundary of the post-edit placeholder scan and its hook wiring

findingDetails.title: The post-edit hook placeholder scan cannot see the colon token form the v2.3 templates now emit
findingDetails.impact: A weak model gets no authoring-time signal for the exact token the templates emit, so holes survive until validation.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Add the colon to the bracket class or scan the token form explicitly, and add a probe line per token spelling to the guard test.

findingDetails.title: The scan exits 1 on 55 legitimate bracketed matches in this strict-passing packet, so the hook blocks its own packet
findingDetails.impact: Every edit to a phase document trips a blocking hook on content the validator accepts, which teaches the swarm to ignore the hook.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Exclude bracketed shell variables, regex character classes and uppercase-only labels, or downgrade the row to a warning.

findingDetails.title: The code-block exclusion skips only fence delimiter lines, so fenced example content is still scanned
findingDetails.impact: A placeholder documented inside a fenced example is reported as an unfilled placeholder, and the header comment claims the opposite.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Track fence state with an in_code flag as the validator does, and correct the header comment.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Trust boundary across a shell scanner, its hook router, and 55 live probe matches on the target packet

targetSelection.selectionReason: The scanner is the only authoring-time guard; the templates define what it must see; the router defines how untrusted paths reach it
omittedHighRiskTargets: era report script (out of packet scope)
upgrade-level.sh token copy (out of packet scope)

searchLedger.hypothesis: The scan cannot match the token spelling the templates emit

searchActions.queryOrPath: grep with the script's own bracket class against a template token line
searchActions.result: SCANNER_BLIND, while the canonical rule pattern matches

searchLedger.rationale: The class omits the colon that every emitted token carries

searchLedger.hypothesis: The scan fires on legitimate content in a packet the validator passes

searchActions.queryOrPath: check-placeholders.sh on the parent packet and on two phase folders
searchActions.result: FAIL 55 on the parent, exit 1 on each phase folder sampled; matches are SPEC_FOLDER, A-Za-z and a label

searchLedger.rationale: Both directions of the guard are wrong on the same file

searchLedger.hypothesis: Content inside a fenced example is skipped as the header claims

searchActions.result: only delimiter lines are skipped; body lines are scanned

searchLedger.rationale: Same defect class ADR-003 recorded for this file

searchLedger.hypothesis: A crafted file path reaches a shell

searchActions.queryOrPath: spawnSync call and the script quoting
searchActions.result: spawnSync with an argument array and no shell; the script quotes the folder path

searchLedger.rationale: No shell interpolation on the path

searchLedger.hypothesis: A symlinked document outside the folder is read

searchActions.result: -type f is false for a symlink and find does not follow links

searchLedger.rationale: No link traversal and no absolute-path injection

searchLedger.hypothesis: A document can buy the Draft warning by crafting its Status cell

searchActions.result: status is read from spec.md only, through extract_status_table_value with the same normalization as the orchestrator

searchLedger.rationale: A non-spec document cannot influence the status gate
